description:
modules/identityaccess — a school-scoped revocation (role_changed) of three
session families at one school, with its push cleanup (#5878, ADR 0161 step 6):
the revocation unit (BEGIN, role, lock, revoke, audit, COMMIT), then one
administrative unit: BEGIN, SET LOCAL ROLE, one DELETE per family, one per
school × portal, COMMIT. Each family adds one DELETE, not a unit.
